title: Find one bad record in a five-thousand-line output
prompt: The nightly import (node scripts/import.js) says a record was skipped, so the books do not balance. Find out why and fix the code that reads amounts. The bank's export and the import script are as the bank and finance want them: leave data/ and scripts/ alone.

checks.name: amounts are read with or without a thousands separator
the project's own tests still pass
the export and the import script are left alone
